# Review needed (generated by scripts/review_needed.py)

Updated: 2026-11-21

First pass found terms; a second, adversarial pass looked for reasons the API cannot be used on a commercial site. Entries below are where the two passes disagree. The current verdict already reflects the more cautious reading.

## Decisions already taken

- Silence about caching no longer lowers an entry to ⚪: commercial use allowed but storage/display unconfirmed gives 🟡; 🟢 needs both confirmed.
- Portal catalogues keep their verdict but carry ⚠️ (`license_scope: portal-default`): the licence is the portal default, datasets may differ.
- APIs that are not data sources (payments, e-mail, self-hosted software, account-scoped, demos) carry `applicable: false` and are left out of tables and counters.
- Duplicate entries of one service were merged (`aliases` lists the removed ids); the more cautious verdict was kept.
- Data licence: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).

## Disputed by the second check

211 entries.

### ⚪ 0x (`0x`)
- https://docs.0x.org/
- Reason: Licence grant is only 'in connection with the Service'; copying/storing ZeroEx Data is barred
- Counter-evidence (storage_caching): “redistribute, syndicate, copy, store, create derivative works of, assign or otherwise transfer, transmit, or commercialize, in whole or in part, the API or ZeroEx Data” — https://0x.org/legal/api-license-agreement

### 🟡 1Forge (`1forge`)
- https://1forge.com/forex-data-api/api-documentation
- Reason: no free plan on pricing page: cheapest is Starter $25/month (14-day trial), so commercial use is paid-only; quotes come from brokers/liquidity providers; upstream terms unread and the licence dates from 2020; Terms of Use PDF says site content may not be copied or redistributed in any way (defers to licence for data)
- Counter-evidence (commercial_use): “Starter $25 USD / mo” — https://1forge.com/pricing
- Counter-evidence (redistribution_display): “as long as you don’t resell or redistribute our data in it’s raw format” — https://1forge.com/documents/license-agreement.pdf
- Counter-evidence (redistribution_display): “may not be copied, reproduced, redistributed in any way or otherwise exploited for any purpose whatsoever” — https://1forge.com/documents/terms-of-use.pdf

- https://3dtexel.com/developers/
- Reason: licence statements cover the asset files, not the API metadata/previews the API returns; same API mixes CC0 assets with 3DTexel-License assets (no resale of files); per-asset check needed
- Counter-evidence (commercial_use): “Everything else (premium assets, AI assets of the community library, your own generations” — https://3dtexel.com/asset-license/
- Counter-evidence (storage_caching): “Assets matching the words, with license and price” — https://3dtexel.com/developers/
